products.name: Ginkgo Anklet
products.description: A delicate 925 sterling silver anklet inspired by the graceful form of ginkgo leaves. Designed with fine detailing and a refined silhouette, it adds a subtle touch of elegance to everyday styling. Lightweight and versatile, this piece pairs effortlessly with both casual and occasion looks.

products.name: Palace Bell Anklet
products.description: A graceful 925 sterling silver anklet featuring delicate palace bell-inspired details. Its fine chain and charming accents create an elegant, feminine look that works beautifully for everyday wear as well as festive and special occasions.

products.name: Ruyi Lock Anklet
products.description: A minimalist 925 sterling silver anklet featuring a refined Ruyi-inspired design. The clean chain silhouette is complemented by a delicate central detail, creating an understated piece that can be styled effortlessly on its own or paired with other jewellery.
